provisional_claim: OA exposure changes TE-family expression within a tissue
required_computational_evidence: FDR-controlled contrast, effect size, QC, family-line display

provisional_claim: A TE response is persistent across developmental and intergenerational exposure
required_computational_evidence: Concordant D-C and I-C effects under prespecified criteria

provisional_claim: A TE returns toward control after parental exposure
required_computational_evidence: D-C and D-I evidence plus I-C equivalence criterion
I-C and I-D evidence with no comparable D-C effect

provisional_claim: Parental phenotype modifies a TE response
required_computational_evidence: Estimable interaction plus within-phenotype and family-level estimates
required_external_evidence: Independent families or replication required for general genetic claim

provisional_claim: A particular TE locus is transcribed
required_computational_evidence: Locus-level assignment, strand/read inspection, exclusion of obvious overlap
required_external_evidence: Strand-specific RT-PCR, RACE, or targeted long-read RNA preferred

provisional_claim: A TE is associated with a nearby gene
required_computational_evidence: Adjusted matched-sample association and genomic context

provisional_claim: A TE regulates a nearby gene
required_external_evidence: Reporter plus native-locus perturbation or equivalent causal test
New-insertion DNA evidence from WGS or targeted assay

provisional_claim: The response is conserved in zebrafish
required_computational_evidence: Sequence/synteny analysis plus comparable zebrafish molecular response
Not testable with a generic zebrafish stress experiment
required_external_evidence: Matched intergenerational OA design would be required
